scope: experimental Bundle v2 only; no production default switch

changes.meaning: Compatibility requires positive, typed, directly matching endpoint terms; target membership alone is insufficient.
Every differing shared dimension and every applicable distinct-dimension bridge needs separate authorization; symmetry is explicit and transitivity is absent.
Self-joins are checked by premise occurrence, including negated ordinary premises and mapped completeness carriers.
Witness payload membership cannot supply a head context; an ordinary positive carrier or exact authorized endpoint must supply it.
All closure columns map to distinct typed target columns; target contexts are covered and every mapped scope term must match.
Derived completeness requires an explicit named exact-rule policy retaining a positive completeness premise.
A v2 derivation without a matching, independently recomputed complete evaluation basis is partially checked and cannot be promoted.
V2 contracts reject legacy compatibility fields, mixed Bundle versions, and conflicting declarations.
